selection_note: Reference coordinate and windows selected from independent event documentation before inspecting detector output. Labels remain provisional at pixel/AOI scale.

park-fire-event.label: Documented fire event; AOI change candidate requiring imagery review
park-fire-event.selection_basis: A 1 km square at CAL FIRE's published incident reference point. The fire began July 24, within the target week. This does not label every cell as burned.

references.supports: Incident start July 24, 2024 and reference coordinate [39.7789, -121.76168].
Independent Landsat observations on July 26 and July 27 show the regional fire and burn scar.

park-fire-pre-event.label: Pre-event control candidate; quiet conditions not established
park-fire-pre-event.selection_basis: Same square as the event case, ending before the documented July 24 start. Other ground, weather and vegetation changes still require review.

references.supports: The target window ends before the documented incident start. This alone is not evidence that all imagery is unchanged.
January 23, 2020 groundbreaking and February 2 delivery of the emergency public-health hospital.

Hospital footprint location, using way version 9 from January 14, 2024; geometry locator, not dated construction or quiet ground truth.

huoshenshan-event.label: Documented rapid hospital construction; surface-change candidate requiring imagery review
huoshenshan-event.selection_basis: 500 m square at the midpoint of OSM way 766315840 version 9 bounds, frozen before detector output. Target Jan 27-Feb 3 brackets documented ongoing construction and delivery. The rolling Dec 30-Jan 27 baseline includes Jan 23-26 initial work; it is not a pure pre-construction baseline.

references.supports: January 23, 2020 groundbreaking and February 2 delivery of the emergency public-health hospital.

huoshenshan-pre-event.selection_basis: Same frozen square, with target Jan 13-Jan 20 ending before documented Jan 23 groundbreaking. Other surface, weather and vegetation changes remain possible.

huoshenshan-nearby.label: Nearby comparison candidate; quiet conditions not established
